profile:
## Dave

**Identity/work:** Dave is an automotive engineer who owns a car-maintenance shop. He works on maintenance, restorations, modifications, engine swaps, suspension and body work, and hopes to build a custom car from scratch. He also joined a rock band, plays/practices guitar, writes lyrics and notes, and started a car-modification blog.

**Family/relationships:** His father introduced him to cars: they restored a car together during Dave’s childhood. Dave and Calvin are supportive friends who plan music jams and Boston meetups.

**Interests/activities:** Classic cars, restoration, auto shows and engineering; walks and parks; hiking and mountain trips; road trips; concerts, festivals and classic rock; vinyl; photography (especially nature, sunsets, beaches, waves, waterfalls and cityscapes); card nights. Repairing cars is therapeutic and gives him purpose. He enjoys helping customers and neighbors and making people happy.

**Possessions/projects:** A garage/shop with cars, including restored Mustangs and vintage cars; a classic-car restoration project targeted for completion by September 2023; a rock-band logo; a vintage camera bought in November 2023.

**Values/goals:** Dave values patience, detail, creativity, learning, dedication and transforming broken things into something beautiful. He wants to keep learning auto engineering and build a custom car.

**Timeline:**  
- **2022:** Restored and sold a car to a collector.  
- **Mar 18–19, 2023:** Saw Aerosmith at a Boston festival.  
- **May 1, 2023:** Opened his own shop.  
- **Jun–Jul 2023:** Walked in Boston parks; booked a July mountain trip.  
- **Aug–Oct 2023:** Attended restoration/modification workshops, restored and modified cars, joined a band, and attended concerts/car shows.  
- **Sep 2023:** Jammed with his band and restored a vintage car.  
- **Oct–Nov 2023:** Finished a restoration, started his blog, and bought a vintage camera.

## Calvin

**Identity/work:** Calvin is a musician, performer and recording artist. He tours and collaborates with Frank Ocean and other artists, produces beats, makes albums and music videos, and supports young musicians. His music expresses his story, emotions and perspectives.

**Family/relationships:** Family and friends support him; an old high-school friend encouraged his early freestyle ambitions. Calvin and Dave encourage one another.

**Interests/activities:** Live performance, songwriting, studio work, collaboration, experimentation with genres/electronic sounds, Japanese culture, city exploration, food, cars and long drives, films (especially *Ratatouille*), concerts, music documentaries and Japanese gardens. He enjoys creating spaces for inspiration.

**Possessions:** A Ferrari/red sports car (repaired after a June 2023 crash; he later acquired another Ferrari), a diamond-pendant necklace from an artist, a custom octopus-design guitar made by a Japanese artist friend, and a studio with keyboard, synthesizer and other equipment. He transformed a Japanese mansion into a recording studio and has a separate relaxation room.

**Values/goals:** Staying authentic and unique, connection with audiences, creativity, growth, perseverance and paying it forward. Goals include global touring, expanding his brand and fanbase, reaching more people, collaborating worldwide and making an impact.

**Timeline:**  
- **Apr–Jul 2023:** Traveled/lived in Japan, performed and collaborated there; toured with Frank Ocean.  
- **Jun 16–Jul 7:** Car accident; car repaired.  
- **Aug 2023:** Performed in Japan, secured continued work with Frank Ocean, and filmed an album video in Miami.  
- **Sep 11:** Released an album.  
- **Oct 2023:** Met Boston artists, networked, toured with Frank Ocean and planned a November Tokyo visit.  
- **Oct 26–Nov 1:** Held an album celebration in Japan.  
- **Nov 2023:** Supported young musicians, attended a Boston gala, and accepted a future Boston performance invitation.
